title: Ezekiel 39
paragraphs: ¹ "Son of man, prophesy against Gog and say: This is what the Lord GOD says: I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal. ² I will turn you around and drag you along. I will bring you from the far north and send you against the mountains of Israel. ³ I will strike your bow from your left hand and make your arrows drop from your right hand. ⁴ On the mountains of Israel you will fall, you and all your troops and the nations with you. I will give you as food to all kinds of carnivorous birds and to the wild animals. ⁵ You will fall in the open field, for I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.

⁶ I will send fire on Magog and on those who live in safety in the coastlands, and they will know that I am the LORD. ⁷ I will make my holy name known among my people Israel. I will not let my holy name be profaned anymore. Then the nations will know that I the LORD am the Holy One in Israel. ⁸ It is coming! It will happen, declares the Lord GOD. This is the day I have spoken of. ⁹ Then those who live in the towns of Israel will go out and use the weapons for fuel — the shields and bucklers, the bows and arrows, the war clubs and spears — and they will make fires with them for seven years. ¹⁰ They will not need to gather wood from the fields or cut it from the forests, because they will use the weapons for fuel. They will plunder those who plundered them and loot those who looted them, declares the Lord GOD.

¹¹ On that day I will give Gog a burial place in Israel — the valley of those who travel east of the sea. It will block the path of travelers, because Gog and all his multitude will be buried there. It will be called the Valley of Hamon-gog. ¹² For seven months the house of Israel will be burying them in order to cleanse the land. ¹³ All the people of the land will help with the burial, and it will bring them honor on the day I am glorified, declares the Lord GOD. ¹⁴ They will appoint men to continually search the land and bury any remains left on the ground, in order to cleanse it. After seven months, they will begin the search. ¹⁵ As those who travel through the land survey it, whenever someone sees a human bone, they will set up a marker beside it until the gravediggers have buried it in the Valley of Hamon-gog.

¹⁶ A town called Hamonah will also be there. In this way they will cleanse the land. ¹⁷ And you, son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says: Speak to every kind of bird and to all the wild animals: "Assemble and come together from all around for the sacrifice I am making for you — a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel. There you will eat flesh and drink blood. ¹⁸ You will eat the flesh of mighty men and drink the blood of the princes of the earth — the rams, lambs, goats, and bulls — all of them fattened animals from Bashan. ¹⁹ At my sacrifice, which I will prepare for you, you will eat fat until you are full and drink blood until you are drunk. ²⁰ At my table you will fill yourselves with horses and riders, with mighty men and all kinds of warriors, declares the Lord GOD."

²¹ I will display my glory among the nations, and all the nations will witness my judgment that I execute and my hand that I lay upon them. ²² From that day forward, the house of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God. ²³ And the nations will know that the house of Israel went into exile because of their sin — because they were unfaithful to me, I hid my face from them and handed them over to their enemies, and they all fell by the sword. ²⁴ I dealt with them according to their uncleanness and their rebellions, and I hid my face from them. ²⁵ Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Now I will restore the fortunes of Jacob and have compassion on the whole house of Israel, and I will be zealous for my holy name.

²⁶ They will forget their shame and all the unfaithfulness they showed toward me when they lived securely in their land with no one to frighten them. ²⁷ When I have brought them back from the peoples and gathered them out of the lands of their enemies, I will be shown holy through them in the sight of many nations. ²⁸ Then they will know that I am the LORD their God, who sent them into exile among the nations, and who gathered them back to their own land. I will not leave any of them behind. ²⁹ I will no longer hide my face from them, for I will pour out my Spirit on the house of Israel, declares the Lord GOD.
